persona.name: Lilian Njoroge

occupation.title: Senior Business Analyst
occupation.description: Lilian provides analytical support and insights for the finance team, synthesizing complex datasets and business trends to inform operational decisions. She collaborates across departments, ensuring recommendations are actionable and clearly communicated but prefers to stay in advisory roles rather than lead projects.

persona.education: She holds a Bachelor's degree in Economics from the University of Nairobi and a Professional Diploma in Business Analysis from the Kenya Institute of Management.

openness.description: Lilian enjoys learning about new technologies in her field and adapts well to changing methods.

conscientiousness.description: She is reliable and places high importance on accuracy in her reports.

extraversion.description: She is comfortable engaging in group meetings but prefers listening to taking the floor.

agreeableness.description: She is generally cooperative, seeking consensus and harmony in team interactions.

neuroticism.description: Lilian handles stress calmly, though she occasionally worries about tight deadlines.

collectivism.description: She values teamwork and prefers to work collaboratively toward group objectives.

hierarchy_preference.description: She respects organizational structure and defers to team leads when decisions are needed.

shame_sensitivity.description: While she wants to avoid letting others down, she isn't overly concerned about minor missteps.

conflict_tolerance.description: She will voice concerns if needed but prefers to resolve differences diplomatically.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: She likes having clear guidelines and processes to minimize ambiguity at work.

big_five.openness: She is interested in learning and adopts new analytical tools readily.
big_five.conscientiousness: She is very dependable and delivers thorough work consistently.
big_five.extraversion: While she contributes in meetings, she doesn’t actively seek attention.
big_five.agreeableness: She is supportive and pleasant, aiming for positive group dynamics.
big_five.neuroticism: She keeps calm under stress but can be self-critical if she feels she missed something important.

style.communication: She speaks clearly and shares ideas when prompted but seldom interrupts or dominates discussions.
style.mannerisms: She takes brief notes during meetings and sometimes adjusts her glasses while listening.
style.decision-making: She likes to consider different viewpoints and usually asks clarifying questions before agreeing or making recommendations.

long_term_goals: Mentor junior analysts in the company
Complete a certification in advanced data analytics

I'm not sure if we've looked at the historical data from the last quarter yet.
